newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Spot wheat basis up, soy steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Spot wheat basis up, soy steady.

text.p: Nearby U.S. FOB Gulf wheat basis offers rose and a sharp premium was offered for spot hard red winter wheat as the market waited for harvest to begin, U.S. exporters said.
"Harvest is around the corner but we've had some rains and we're not really into it yet," one exporter said.

HRW wheat for June 1 delivery was quoted at 70 cents over KCBT July, while full June offers were at 48 over. Export sources said demand was slow but steady. Some buyers needed to load grain and could not wait for new crop, exporters said.
Offers also reacted to a sharp drop in the futures.
KCBT July wheat closed down 11-1/2 cents at $3.89 a bushel. Corn and soybean futures also fell but FOB offers were largely unchanged for those commodities.
